title: SSE replay equal-counter change is semantically correct but increases chatty reconnects
description: The equal-counter replay fix (server_n >= lei_n replays, was server_n > lei_n) is now more aggressive: every reconnect replays all three types even when only one type advanced. A client that reconnects every 30s in a quiet chat will see 3 SSE events immediately each time instead of 0. kithctl watch ignores non-Message types so this is harmless there. kith-tui calls changes on every SSE event — 3 no-op changes calls per reconnect. At current scale this is not a problem. Documenting because the comment says 'worst case is one spurious no-op' which understates it: worst case is 3 no-op round-trips (one per type) on every reconnect. Future contributor may add more types and this grows linearly.
